markers.reading: The four PCs and Seeker IV stand in the pine-grove hillock with Szoltár; Leizar and the caregiver later approach this same ongoing position.

evidence.quote: the four of you, plus simulacrum Seeker
that’s where you’re standing now.

markers.reading: The five turn into eagles and fly up the Aursen and its tributary to Three Wells, landing near the large council tent.

duration.basis: Narrated couple of hours of flight.

route.reading: Follow the river upriver, then its small tributary up the valley.
Refugee huts and nearby tents are seen from the air; no landing there is established.

evidence.quote: you turn into birds and you… launch into the sky.

markers.reading: Marcella meets the five and leads them into the council tent at Three Wells.

evidence.quote: Come, I… I’ve already… told them
the flaps of the tent aside, and you step into a room.

markers.reading: After the private interrogation, the PCs go among the crowd at Three Wells and pull Perrin and Guilhem aside to report the prisoner’s thoughts.

markers.reading: Delwath scries the resting Iron Fang camp and the Empress patrolling its perimeter. She blinds the sensor; strange transforming-landscape flashes follow.
markers.note: The flashes do not establish travel to Limbo or a verified identity for the viewed landscape.
